instruments_timeframes: Source does not impose a universal market/timeframe; use chart-selected symbol and timeframe unless the script inputs specify otherwise.
indicators: Inputs (source declarations): src = input(defval=close, title='Source'); len = input.int(defval=20, title='Length', minval=10); devlen = input.float(defval=2.3, title='Deviation', minval=0.1, step=0.1); extendit = input(defval=true, title='Extend Lines'); showfibo = input(defval=false, title='Show Fibonacci Levels'); showbroken = input.bool(defval=true, title='Show Broken Channel', inline='brk'); brokencol = input.color(defval=color.blue, title='', inline='brk'); upcol = input.color(defval=color.lime, title='Up/Down Trend Colors', inline='trcols'); dncol = input.color(defval=color.red, title='', inline='trcols'); widt = input(defval=2, title='Line Width'); issl = input.bool(title='SL', inline='linesl1', group='Stop Loss / Take Profit:', defval=false); slpercent = input.float(title=', %', inline='linesl1', group='Stop Loss / Take Profit:', defval=18.0, minval=0.0, step=0.1); istp = input.bool(title='TP', inline='linetp1', group='Stop Loss / Take Profit:', defval=false); tppercent = input.float(title=', %', inline='linetp1', group='Stop Loss / Take Profit:', defval=18.0, minval=0.0, step=0.1)
entry_long: Source rule: (slope  is below  0 with all conditions true close  exceeds  y2_ + dev * devlen) with either condition true (slope  exceeds  0 with all conditions true close  exceeds  y2_ + dev * devlen)
entry_short: Source rule: (slope  exceeds  0 with all conditions true close  is below  y2_ - dev * devlen) with either condition true (slope  is below  0 with all conditions true close  is below  y2_ - dev * devlen)
exit: Source submits this exit order from the surrounding strategy flow: strategy.exit(id='Exit Long', from_entry='Long', stop=issl ? stoploss : na, limit=istp ? takeprofit : na, alert_message='Exit Long'); Source submits this exit order from the surrounding strategy flow: strategy.exit(id='Exit Short', from_entry='Short', stop=issl ? stoploss : na, limit=istp ? takeprofit : na, alert_message='Exit Short')
stop_loss: strategy.exit(id='Exit Long', from_entry='Long', stop=issl ? stoploss : na, limit=istp ? takeprofit : na, alert_message='Exit Long'); strategy.exit(id='Exit Short', from_entry='Short', stop=issl ? stoploss : na, limit=istp ? takeprofit : na, alert_message='Exit Short')
take_profit: strategy.exit(id='Exit Long', from_entry='Long', stop=issl ? stoploss : na, limit=istp ? takeprofit : na, alert_message='Exit Long'); strategy.exit(id='Exit Short', from_entry='Short', stop=issl ? stoploss : na, limit=istp ? takeprofit : na, alert_message='Exit Short')
position_sizing: Source strategy() declaration determines defaults when present; no exchange risk budget is inferred. See source for qty/default_qty_type/default_qty_value.
filters: Only conditions present in the cited source are represented in entry rules; no external filters added.
implementation_notes: Paraphrased from the cited Pine source file. Third-party Pine source; verify execution timing, pyramiding, and broker-emulator semantics before implementation.
